description: This file defines classes and interfaces for handling WebSocket connections, including WebSocket handlers, factories, server interactions, HTTP status codes, and dynamic request handlers within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketHandler
classes.description: Abstract class for handling WebSocket events such as receiving messages, connection establishment, and closure.

classes.name: WebSocketHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating WebSocketHandler instances.

classes.name: DynHandler
classes.description: Abstract class for handling dynamic HTTP requests, supporting GET and POST methods.

methods.name: OnReceive
methods.description: Virtual method called when a message is received over WebSocket.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Virtual method called when a WebSocket connection is established.

methods.name: OnClosed
methods.description: Virtual method called when a WebSocket connection is closed.

methods.name: EnqueueMessage
methods.description: Enqueues a message to be sent over WebSocket.

methods.name: OnWritable
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket is writable.

methods.name: DoGet
methods.description: Handles a GET request in DynHandler.

methods.name: DoPost
methods.description: Handles a POST request in DynHandler.

methods.name: AppendDataOut
methods.description: Appends data to the output buffer for sending.

methods.name: AppendDataIn
methods.description: Appends data to the input buffer.

methods.name: OnWritable
methods.description: Handles writable event for dynamic data.

methods.name: content_len
methods.description: Returns the length of the content.
